principle: A prefab concept is not guaranteed manufacturable until a supplier accepts the configuration and the required local professional/regulatory checks are complete.

modes.name: Standard catalogue model
modes.description: Use a supplier's existing house/module substantially as published.

modes.name: Design inside a known factory system
modes.description: Load supplier grid, span, opening, stacking, connection and transport rules into the design engine; create a house only inside that configuration envelope.
modes.advantage: Highest chance that the AI concept translates directly to one supplier's production system.

modes.name: Design first, tender to prefab suppliers
modes.description: Product Twin creates a performance- and geometry-defined house concept independent of one factory, then invites compatible prefab suppliers to respond with feasibility, required design changes, engineering route, price, programme and logistics.
modes.supplier_commitment_needed: factory feasibility acceptance + engineering proposal + commercial bid
modes.advantage: Lets the user design the house they want first and lets factories compete to industrialize it.

modes.name: Selected factory adapts the concept
modes.description: After tendering, choose a preferred factory and allow it to translate the concept into its manufacturing system while Product Twin tracks every deviation from the approved design intent.

selection_rule: Never label an open bespoke prefab design as an orderable Product Twin until a named supplier has accepted the geometry/configuration and the required engineering/regulatory gates have passed.
